作为腐化者市长获得胜利

values.english: I know what I have to do but I don't know if I have the strength to do it.
values.schinese: 我知道我必须做,但是我不知道我是否有这个能力.

values.english: Hop in there, I dare ya.
Now you see me, now you don't.
values.schinese: 你看得见我了,你又看不见我了,你又看得见我了...

values.english: A body? Where? I need it.
I once made a pencil using 2 erasers...they were pointless, just like me.
values.schinese: 我需要一支铅笔和俩橡皮......的确这些东西现在没什么用,但是以后也没什么用,就像我.

values.english: I am skilled in identifying blood...yup that's not ketchup.
values.schinese: 我很擅长辨别血液.....嗯....这不是番茄酱!而是血!

values.english: How am I going to stop some big mean mother hubbard from tearing me a structurally superfluous new behind? The solution? Use a wrench. And if that don't work, use more wrench.
Today, I will make you a man.
values.schinese: 今天,我会让你变成真男人~

values.english: Um, those votes are legitimate. No, the votes are not rigged.
values.schinese: 额,这些票是合法合规的...?哦不,他们并不是被人为操纵的.

values.english: Doth thou solemnly swear thine allegiance to the lord?
values.schinese: 你郑重地向主宣誓效忠吗？

values.english: The voices...they are telling me...my breath stinks? Can ghosts even smell?
values.schinese: 那些声音....他们在跟我说....我很臭???鬼魂有嗅觉?

values.english: The only thing you need to find out information is good placement and amazing levels of patience.
values.schinese: 你想获得信息只需要有一个藏东西的好位置以及足够的耐心就行
死个船员让我套啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊,坏批是什么fvv啊???

values.english: I have no idea who I am or what is it that I do, the only thing I know is to finish my job.
values.schinese: 我忘了我是谁或者我在做什么,我只是想完成我的任务...

values.english: Guys I promise I'm not an Executioner, I checked Blue and they're sus.
values.schinese: 孩子们,我保证我不是处刑人,我查了蓝色,铁坏的!

values.english: GET BACK HERE I WANT YOUR ROLE.
I only took up this job because the others were full. Yes it's a proper job. No, I'm not a stalker.
values.schinese: 我做这个工作只是因为其他工作不招人了.是的一份非常适合我的工作....eee,我真的不是变态

values.english: You're here and you're there. Where will you go? That's for me to decide.
values.schinese: 你在这呀你在那~你该去哪呢~点兵点将....

values.english: Just step over there kind sir.
values.schinese: 先生,您能不能在这个地方待会儿?
面对我!如果你有这个胆!

values.english: I AM THE HAND OF JUSTICE.
values.schinese: 我!就!是!正!义!以雷霆击碎黑暗!!!!

values.english: I am totally what you think of me as.

values.schinese: 啊啊啊我亡了这个子怎么与(嘟嘟哒嘟嘟哒)

values.english: I like my meat well done.
The back that trusts me the most is the sweetest to stab.
values.schinese: 这群byd不值得我为他们工作!

values.english: You can run, but you can't hide.
values.schinese: 躲得过初一,躲不过十五

values.english: How do you survive with no food but with a lot of people? Improvise, adapt, overcome.
values.schinese: 出门带好葱姜蒜,别让拔叔太难办

values.english: Everyone calls me a pain in the neck.
values.schinese: 每个人都叫我脖子毁灭者
关键语句:兄弟你必须信我啊!

values.english: Hippity hoppity, your code is now my property.
values.schinese: 点一下,再一下~你的财产是我的啦~
别哭了孩子....妈妈在这呢.

values.english: I want to know what you are.
Hehehe I wonder if I do this...
The doctor told me bones grow stronger when receiving damage. But then why did he kick me out when I picked up a hammer?
values.schinese: 开辟天地的使者,如今降临于此,吾等凡人,还不快快v我50?

values.english: I like my women like how I like my knives, sharp and painful.
values.schinese: 我爱我的老婆就像我爱我的刀一样,尖酸而刻薄

values.english: I like the dead, they do a lot of things I like. For example, staying dead. But I exist to change that.
values.schinese: 我喜欢死人,他们身上有很多优点.比如,他们静静地躺着,但是能够改变

values.english: I am the god of disease, nothing can kill me.
values.schinese: I am the STORM that is approaching!!!!

values.english: I'm the one who you should not have killed.
values.schinese: 我是那个你不该杀的人(对紫色老登说)

values.english: Cough This should surely work, right? Cough I sure hope it does.
values.schinese: 咳咳咳这应该有用,对吧?咳咳咳我很希望这有用...
我总是会归来!(紫色老登音)

values.english: Hey listen man, I mind my own business and you mind yours. Everyone wins! ... Why are you coming closer?
values.schinese: 嘿听着伙计,我活我的你刀你的.我们这是双赢!...不是,你为什么在靠近我?
你知道吗....对对对....v我50马上带你赢啊....
说中了我一部分真幸运啊
让我摸摸你的屁...身份牌:)

values.english: Today, I'll make you an even bigger man.
values.schinese: 今天,我会让你成为更大的男人♂

values.english: Here, wear this for me please. I promise I won't do anything to you.
values.schinese: 嘿老兄,帮我试穿下这个.我保证不会对你做什么的:))))))

values.english: You will do as I say...unless you want to be the painting on the walls.
values.schinese: 我说什么你就做....除非你想成为那个纪念碑上的一员.
我诅咒你全家!!我*******你******你全家都***我***你的****我***你全家

values.english: I'm going to make an offer they can't refuse.
values.schinese: 我会开出你无法拒绝的条件.

values.english: If you ever feel useless, just remember I exist.
values.schinese: 如果你觉得自己很没用,那就想想我的存在吧(对船员).

values.english: I'm the guy you call to clean up after you.
values.schinese: 诶先生,是您叫的客房清理服务是吧,好嘞马上打扫干净...

values.english: Casually observing the chaos over Green seeing Red kill. It was me.
values.schinese: <i>绿色说着红色杀人而红色在挂机<i>对的,那是我

values.english: He's here, he's there, he's everywhere. Who are ya gonna call? Psychic friend Fr-
values.schinese: 他在这~他在那~他到处都是~你想要打给谁?超自然之友....

values.english: If you ever feel useless, just remember that I also exist.
values.schinese: 如果你觉得自己很没用,那也想想我的存在(对伪装者和船员)

values.english: HAHAHA YOU CAN'T SEE VERY WELL CAN YOU NOW?
values.schinese: 哈哈,你现在不太看的清了对吧?

values.english: I WILL PURGE THIS UNHOLY LAND!
values.schinese: 你觉得你很强?那就拿出你最强的一击吧!

values.english: I'm a great matchmaker, trust me.
values.schinese: 我是个很强的媒婆,相信我.

values.english: Who knew old documents can get people into trouble?
values.schinese: 你知道旧文件可以让人们陷入恐慌吗?

values.english: So now if you mix these together, you end up creating this...thing.
values.schinese: 总之,把这些混在一起,然后你就能得到...这玩意

values.english: Everyone! We will be playing dress up! TOGETHER!

values.schinese: 我会一直视奸着你...一直...

values.english: I CURSE YOU TO SUCK ONE THOUSAND D-
KIDNEYS! I GOT NEW KIDNEYS! I don't like the colour.
values.schinese: 肾!肾回来了!从今天开始我要戒色...(1小时后)肾宝,味道好极了~

values.english: You can hide, but you can't run.
This symbol is a placeholder for when one doesn't have a disposition or subfaction that they are part of.
values.schinese: 这个标志是个填空用的,为了某些没有天资或副阵营的人而使用

values.english: Players who have shields deployed on them through a Medic or Retributionist-Medic.
values.schinese: 通过战地医师或模仿者模仿的战地医师而获得的盾牌

values.english: Players who have been knighted by a Monarch receive this symbol.
values.schinese: 被君王任命的家伙会有这个标记

values.english: Players that have been trapped by a Trapper or Retributionist-Trapper. Trapped players will have their interactors' roles logged and sent to the relevant Trapper. If the trapped target is attacked, the trap will remove all of its logged roles and attack the attacker. The Trapper is notified if the trap attacked someone, and if not, they get a list of roles that interacted with their targets.
values.schinese: 被设陷者或模仿者模仿的设陷者放置的陷阱的玩家.被困住的玩家将会把与其互动的玩家职业记录并发送给设陷者.如果被困住的玩家被攻击,那么陷阱记录将会移除记录的职业并攻击那个凶手.如果陷阱被触发击杀那么设陷者将会收到消息,如果没有,那么设陷者将会收到与被困住玩家互动的玩家的名单

values.english: Players who have been doused by an Arsonist. Doused players can be ignited by the Arsonist from anywhere.
values.schinese: 被纵火狂涂油的玩家.可随时被身处任意地点的纵火狂点燃

values.english: Targets of a Bounty Hunter will have this symbol on their name. All targets know there is a bounty on their head.
values.schinese: 赏金猎人的目标的名字后面将会有这个标志.所有悬赏目标都知道自己被悬赏

values.english: Players who have been doused by a Cryomaniac. Doused players can be frozen by the Cryomaniac from anywhere.
values.schinese: 被冰冻狂涂冷凝剂的玩家.可随时被处于任意地点的冰冻狂冰冻

values.english: The symbol that means one is part of the Undead subfaction.
values.schinese: 这个标志意味着你的副阵营是不死族

values.english: Players being tormented by an Executioner. Avoid ejecting them to increase your chances of winning.
values.schinese: 被处刑人选为目标的玩家,不要票出他们,不然白打工:)

values.english: Players being watched by a Guardian Angel. Try to recruit them or their GA to your side to increase your chances of winning.
values.schinese: 守护天使的目标.你可以试试招募他或者他的天使:)

values.english: Players being protected by their Guardian Angel.
values.schinese: 玩家正在被守护天使守护

values.english: Players being agonised by a Guesser. If the player is on your team, avoid revealing their role publicly to increase your chances of winning.
values.schinese: 被猜测者选为猜测目标的玩家.如果该玩家在你的阵营中,那么避免他们的职业被揭示:)

values.english: The symbol that means one is part of the Cabal subfaction.
values.schinese: 这标志意味着你的副阵营为豺狼阵营

values.english: The symbol that means one is part of the Reanimated subfaction.
values.schinese: 这标志意味着你现在的副阵营是亡灵阵营

values.english: Players that have been infected by a Plaguebearer. Once everyone is infected, the Plaguebearer becomes Pestilence.
values.schinese: 被瘟疫之源感染的玩家.一旦所有人被感染,瘟疫之源将变为万疫之神

values.english: This symbol denotes how many stacks of the plague a certain player has.
values.schinese: 这个标志记录着你现在身上有多少病毒.

values.english: Survivors who currently have their vests active.
values.schinese: 求生者启用他们防弹衣时的图标

values.english: The symbol that means one is part of the Cult subfaction.
values.schinese: 这个标志意味着你现在的副阵营是邪教阵营

values.english: Players who are framed by a Framer or Rebel-Framer. Framed players can die without triggering penalties for killers like Vigilante and Assassin.
values.schinese: 被陷害者或反叛头领-陷害者陷害的玩家.被陷害的玩家可以不需要经过判定就能够直接被类似于侠客和刺客的职业击杀

values.english: Players who have been spellbound by a Spellslinger or Rebel-Spellslinger. When all non-Syndicate players are spellbound, the game will immediately end in the Spellslinger's victory.
values.schinese: 被咒术师或反叛头领-咒术师诅咒的玩家.当所有非无政府组织玩家全都被诅咒时,游戏将会立刻以咒术师的胜利而结束

values.english: Players who have been blackmailed by a Blackmailer or Godfather-Blackmailer. Blackmailed players cannot speak in chat.
values.schinese: 被勒索者或教父-勒索者勒索的玩家.被勒索的玩家无法在聊天框里交流

values.english: Players who have been silenced by a Silencer or Rebel-Silencer. Silenced players cannot see anything in chat aside from system messages.
values.schinese: 被静语者或反叛头领-静语者静语的玩家.被静语的玩家无法看见聊天框中任何系统消息

values.english: Players who have been blinded by a Grenadier or Godfather-Grenadier. Flashed players cannot see anything as their screen turns white. Exempted players will have their screen dull out slightly to indicate they were flashed.
values.schinese: 被掷弹兵或-教父掷弹兵闪光的玩家.被闪的玩家看不到任何东西,只有一片白.不能被闪光的玩家屏幕是淡白色,以表示他们在闪光范围内

values.english: The player who currently wields the Chaos Drive within the Syndicate faction
values.schinese: 下个回合能得到混沌能源的无政府组织玩家

values.english: This symbol indicates that they are in the same faction as you, but beware as they could still backstab you
values.schinese: 这个标志意味着他目前与你处于同一阵营,但是他还是可能背刺你

values.english: Players who have been marked by the Ghoul. Marked players will die at the end of the next meeting.
values.schinese: 被恶灵标记的玩家,这个玩家在下个会议结束时死亡

values.english: When enabled, the first person to die in the previous game receives a shield of protection in the next game's first round.
values.schinese: 启用某个选项时,第一个在对局中死亡的玩家会在下一局的第一回合获得此标记

values.english: Players who are on high alert. Alerted players will attack anyone who interacts with them.
values.schinese: 处于高度警戒状态的玩家.警戒状态的玩家会反杀所有与其互动的玩家

values.english: Players being targeted by a Crusader. Crusaded players will attack anyone who interacts with them, or if the Crusader holds the drive, everyone within a certain radius.
values.schinese: 十字军守护的目标.被十字军守护的玩家被互动时会反杀那个玩家,如果十字军拥有混沌能源那么被互动的玩家会把附近所有玩家击杀

values.english: Players being targeted by an Ambusher. Ambushed players will attack anyone who interacts with them.
values.schinese: 被伏兵标记的玩家,被伏击的玩家会反杀与其互动的玩家

values.english: Used to denote those with the Allied disposition. The color denotes which faction they belong to.
values.schinese: 用于表示那些拥有同盟军天资的玩家.不同颜色表示他们所处不同的主阵营

values.english: Used to denote those with the Corrupted disposition.
values.schinese: 用于表示那些拥有腐化者天资的玩家.

values.english: Used to denote those with the Defector disposition. The color denotes which faction they belong to.
values.schinese: 用于表示拥有叛逃者天资的玩家.颜色表示他当前所处的阵营

values.english: Used to denote those with the Fanatic disposition. The color denotes which faction they belong to.
values.schinese: 用于表示拥有狂热追随者天资的玩家.颜色表示他当前所处的阵营

values.english: Used to denote those with the Linked disposition.
values.schinese: 用于表示那些拥有好兄弟天资的玩家.

values.english: Used to denote those with the Lovers disposition.
values.schinese: 用于表示那些拥有恋人天资的玩家.

values.english: Used to denote those with the Mafia disposition.
values.schinese: 用于表示拥有黑帮天资的玩家.

values.english: Used to denote those with the Overlord disposition.
values.schinese: 用于表示拥有霸主天资的玩家.

values.english: Used to denote those with the Rivals disposition. Also used for those with the Taskmaster disposition.
values.schinese: 用于表示那些拥有决斗者天资的玩家.也用于表示拥有任务大师天资的玩家

values.english: Used to denote those with the Taskmaster disposition.
values.schinese: 用于表示拥有任务大师天资的玩家.

values.english: Used to denote those with the Traitor disposition. The color denotes which faction they belong to.
values.schinese: 用于表示那些拥有叛徒天资的玩家.不同颜色表示他们所处不同的主阵营

values.english: The Cult is a group that can gain massive numbers of followers in one go. It may be weak at the start, but do not underestimate them as their powerful growth as it may overrun you. The Cult is led by the Whisperer.
values.schinese: 邪教组织是一个能够获得大量追随者的组织.一开始可能很弱,但是随着时间推移,不要震惊于他们平推整个地图的速度,邪教的领导人是耳语者

values.english: The Cabal is a greedy organisation. They operate covertly by secretly recruiting people to join their group. The Cabal starts off very strong, making them a high-priority threat. They are led by the Jackal.
values.schinese: 豺狼们是个贪心的组织.他们偷偷的在人群中招募着跟班.豺狼们开局时便十分强大,是非常大的威胁,他们的领导人是豺狼

values.english: The Undead are a group of bloodthirsty vampires who slowly grow their numbers. The longer the game progresses, the higher their elimination priority becomes. They are led by the Dracula.
values.schinese: 不死族是一群渴望鲜血的家伙,并且成员数量增长的很慢.随着游戏进程的推进,他们的威胁会越来越大.他们的领导人是吸血鬼

values.english: The Reanimated are individuals who have died yet hold a grudge against the living. This is facilitated by the Necromancer, their leader. Extended periods without confirmed deaths increase suspicion of Necromancer activity.
values.schinese: 亡灵是已死之人但被亡灵巫师复活的倒霉蛋.亡灵巫师是他们的领导人,随着复活人数增加,亡灵巫师的复活冷却时间会越来越长,也会让这群人看起来十分可疑

values.english: This mode is nothing special. Everyone is either a basic Crewmate, Impostor, or Anarchist (if alternate intruders is enabled).
values.schinese: 这个模式没什么可疑的,每个人都是基础职业

values.english: This is the main mode of the game. You can customize the chances of roles appearing and set their maximum instances.
values.schinese: 是最经典的模式.你可以自定义职业出现的概率,以及他们的最大数量.

values.english: This mode has no restrictions on role instances. Each role has a "Uniqueness" property (only 1-2 instances allowed).
values.schinese: 这个模式对职业的数量没有限制.每个职业都会有一个"独一无二"设置(只会生成1-2个该职业)

values.english: A skill-based mode where players race to complete tasks. No killing allowed - victory is determined by task completion speed.
values.schinese: 拥有技能的任务竞速.不允许击杀-胜利条件是做任务足够快

values.english: Create custom role sets with exact alignment/faction counts. The "Uniqueness" property applies here, allowing tailored role distributions.
values.schinese: 创建一个自定义职业表."独一无二"设置仍旧存在,还能禁掉一些比较基础的职业

values.english: An unofficial Hide & Seek variant with two types: Classic (fixed Hunter numbers) and Infection (Hunters convert others). Only two roles spawn initially.
values.schinese:
非官方性的躲猫猫模式,
有两种模式:经典(固定猎人人数)和感染模式(猎人抓到的人会变成猎人).只会生成两种职业.

values.english: Each member has a special ability to deduce identities and combat threats. This faction emphasizes teamwork and deduction. As an uninformed majority, Crewmates form most of the player base and lack knowledge of other members. Completing tasks acts as a timer to pressure non-Crew roles.
values.schinese:
每个船员都有自己的特殊能力以及消除威胁的手段.
这个阵营要求玩家之间有高度的配合以及团队协作.作为游戏中的无组织性的多数派,船员对于其他阵营的认知少之又少,完成任务以给其他阵营的玩家施加压力.

values.english: A destructive faction focused on raw power. Members can kill and use role-specific abilities. As an informed minority, Intruders know each other and coordinate sabotage to disrupt Crew tasks.
values.schinese:
一个破坏性很强的阵营.入侵者们可以击杀以及使用其独特的能力.
作为游戏中少数派,入侵者可互相认出彼此,通过破坏以减缓船员做任务的速度,给自己作案争取时间

values.english: A chaotic faction that gains killing power after meetings. Members start with unique abilities and later unlock the "Chaos Drive," enhancing their capabilities. As an informed minority, they coordinate strategically.
values.schinese:
一个十分混乱的阵营,在会议后会给予他们击杀能力.
无政府组织成员拥有独特的能力,并且在之后会解锁"混沌能源,"这会增强他们的能力.作为游戏中的少数派之一,他们需要一些战术

values.english: A glass cannon faction that starts weak but can become extremely powerful upon completing objectives. Members start with a role specific objective that they must complete to transform into a powerful version of themselves that can greatly affect the flow of a game.
values.schinese:
一个玻璃大炮阵营,一开始十分孱弱,但后期十分强大.
游戏开始时拥有一个目标,完成它之后他们将会获得强大的力量.

values.english: Factionless roles with unique win conditions. Outcasts operate independently in a free-for-all style. As an uninformed minority, they lack team coordination and pursue diverse objectives;some helpful, some not.
values.schinese:
几乎不算一个阵营的阵营,这个阵营的所有人都有自己独特的胜利条件.
被抛弃者拥有自由的游戏节奏.作为游戏中无组织性的少数派之一,他们不需要团队协作,只想着达成说服别人帮他们胜利条件;有的时候有用,有的时候没用:)))))

values.english: A coalition of Outcast Killers and Neophytes. Combines lethal power with conversion abilities, forming a formidable threat. Members coordinate to overwhelm other factions.
values.schinese:
一个由被抛弃者的杀戮型职业和招募型职业混合而来的阵营.
结合了最致命的能力与最NTR的能力,形成了巨大的威胁.对于其他阵营来说过于超模.

values.english: An alliance between Intruders and Syndicate. Leverages sabotage, swift kills, and the enhanced "Chaos Drive" to dominate the ship. Focuses on coordinated strikes and resource control.
values.schinese:
一个处于入侵者和无政府组织之间的阵营.
结合了破坏,击杀,以及使用"混沌能源"加强自身以毁灭整个飞船.擅长位置掌控和资源控制.

values.english: A joint force of Compliance and Pandorica factions. Boasts a vast arsenal of abilities to overpower the Crew. Represents the ultimate challenge for survival-oriented roles.
values.schinese:
服从者与潘多拉联合的阵营.
毁灭性的联合,史诗级的战斗,带给船员的只有绝望,攻守异形,坏人们不再内斗,而是联合.

values.english: Exclusive to special game modes. These roles feature unique mechanics and objectives not found in standard factions. Examples include Hide & Seek variants and task-based competitions.
values.schinese: 独特游戏模式.这些游戏模式里的职业都是模式独占的,比如躲猫猫和任务竞赛的职业

values.english: Revives dead players by extracting mana from bodies, cleaning them in the process.
values.schinese: 用你在尸体上找到的复活药复活死去的玩家,获取复活药的同时会让尸体消失

values.english: Booby traps vents to kill anyone interacting with them.
values.schinese: 用管道陷阱炸死那些跳管的家伙

values.english: Turns invisible to secretly observe other players' actions.
Autopsies bodies to identify killers and generate death reports.
values.schinese: 尸检以确认杀手身份并整合死亡报告

values.english: Basic role with no special abilities - completes tasks to help Crew win.
Campaigns players to gain electoral votes and transform into Mayor.
values.schinese: 拉票以获得更多的票数并转变为市长

values.english: Investigates bloody hands/footprints to identify recent killers.
values.schinese: 调查血迹和脚印以确认最近进行过击杀的玩家

values.english: Calls tribunals to eject extra players, risks suicide if wrong.
values.schinese: 用你的权力驱逐更多玩家,驱逐错误会自杀.

values.english: Fixes sabotages remotely and navigates via vent systems.
values.schinese: 远程修复破坏并灵活的使用管道系统

values.english: Roleblocks players, but dies if blocking dangerous killers.
values.schinese: 封锁其他玩家,但是封锁到强力击杀职业会死亡

values.english: Reveals themselves to gain double voting power.
values.schinese: 揭示自身职业以获得更多票数

values.english: Grants Powerful defense shields to protect players.
values.schinese: 用你强大的盾保护其他玩家

values.english: Communicates with dead players through ghost mediation.
values.schinese: 通过通灵与死去的玩家交流

values.english: Knights players to boost votes and gain personal defense.
values.schinese: 任命其他玩家让他们获得更多票数并获得防御

values.english: Detects subfaction changes and converts to Seer when obsolete.
values.schinese: 检查别人的副阵营有没有改变并在场上所有人都无法改变副阵营的情况下转变为预言家

values.english: Bugs areas to gather intel via Admin Table and Vitals.
values.schinese: 用窃听器,管理地图和生命检测仪获得更多信息

values.english: Mimics dead Crew roles' abilities during meetings.
values.schinese: 在会议中模仿死去船员的职业

values.english: Ghost role that exposes evils upon completing all tasks.
values.schinese: 灵魂职业,做完所有任务以揭示坏人

values.english: Checks for role changes, becomes Sheriff if none exist.
values.schinese: 检查别人的主职业有没有改变,如果场上不可能存在改变则自己变成警长

values.english: Identifies player alliances as Good/Evil through flashes.
values.schinese: 通过屏幕闪光颜色确认其他玩家的好坏

values.english: Swaps roles with others, dies if target is invalid.
values.schinese: 与其他玩家交换身份,如果不可交换则自杀

values.english: Tracks players with continuously updating arrows.
values.schinese: 通过箭头持续追踪玩家

values.english: Swaps player positions, enabling accidental team kills.
values.schinese: 交换玩家位置,可能会导致友军误伤

values.english: Sets traps that log interactions or attack aggressors.
values.schinese: 在别的玩家身上设置陷阱,记录下所有交互或者进行反杀

values.english: Kills anyone interacting with them during alert mode.
values.schinese: 开启警戒并反杀所有与你互动的玩家

values.english: Shoots players but dies if targeting innocents.
values.schinese: 执法,但是杀到无辜的家伙就会死

values.english: Wins by being guessed as a role from their target list; kills successful guessers.
values.schinese: 通过被猜测到列表上的职业以获胜;反杀猜测成功的玩家

values.english: Resurrects dead players' roles to adopt their objectives and win.
values.schinese: 继承死去玩家的职业,完成目标并胜利

values.english: Douses players in gasoline to ignite later for mass elimination.
Emerges as the last faction member; kills enemies to secure victory.
values.schinese: 成为阵营的最后一名玩家则叛变;杀掉敌人确保自己的胜利

values.english: Hunts assigned target using clues; becomes Troll if unsuccessful.
values.schinese: 用线索找到自己的赏金目标;如果目标提前死亡则变为挑衅者

values.english: Consumes corpses to achieve a victory threshold.
values.schinese: 吃尸体,吃到一定数量胜利

values.english: Douses coolant to freeze players during meetings.
Converts players to the Undead faction; lethal against Vampire Hunters.
values.schinese: 把玩家转化到不死族阵营;遇到吸血鬼猎人就寄了

values.english: Gaslights crew to eject a specific target for victory.
values.schinese: 教唆玩家投出你的处刑目标

values.english: Hacks players to disable abilities while mimicking appearances.
values.schinese: 黑入其他玩家以无效他们的能力,或者通过模仿外观迷惑别人

values.english: Shields a target; wins if the target survives.
values.schinese: 保护你的目标;目标胜利则你胜利

values.english: Guesses target's role to kill them; becomes Actor if unsuccessful.
values.schinese: 猜测目标的职业以击杀他们;如果目标死亡则变为演员

values.english: Recruits players into the Cabal faction with opposing roles.
values.schinese: 招募其他玩家加入豺狼阵营

values.english: Seeks ejection to haunt voters posthumously.
Gains stronger kill power with each successful murder.
values.schinese: 每次击杀后减少击杀冷却时间

values.english: Outcast killer with basic attack/defense and no special abilities.
values.schinese: 被抛弃者阵营最基础的杀手,拥有基础攻击和防御且没有特殊能力

values.english: Revives dead players as Reanimated allies.
values.schinese: 复活死去的玩家以让他们加入亡灵阵营

values.english: Infects all players to become an unstoppable killer.
Ghostly role needing task completion without being clicked.
values.schinese: 灵魂职业并需要躲避点击然后做完任务以获胜

values.english: Infects players to eventually transform into Pestilence.
values.schinese: 感染所有玩家然后变为万疫之神

values.english: Kills rapidly during bloodlust phases with short cooldowns.
values.schinese: 在嗜血模式时快速击杀

values.english: Uses vests for temporary immortality to survive.
Steals roles by killing other killers.
values.schinese: 通过击杀其他带刀职业以获得他们的职业

values.english: Kills whoever eliminates them to secure victory.
values.schinese: 挑衅别人,杀掉与你互动的玩家然后获得胜利

values.english: Mauls all players within a radius periodically.
values.schinese: 撕咬所有在攻击范围内的玩家,但是cd是回合性的

values.english: Whispers to convert players to the Cult over time.
values.schinese: 通过耳语让他们加入邪教

values.english: Forces players into alert mode, causing them to attack interactors.
values.schinese: 强制玩家进入警戒模式,让他们击杀与其互动的玩家

values.english: Silences players in meetings, hiding their chat messages.
values.schinese: 让玩家在会议中无法说话,防止他传递所看到的信息

values.english: Makes all players anonymous and grey to disrupt identification.
values.schinese: 让所有玩家患上认知障碍)

values.english: Reveals target roles/factions, blocking future guesses on them.
values.schinese: 揭示目标职业/阵营,当然,他们之后无法被你猜测

values.english: Roleblocks players remotely, risking death against killers.
values.schinese: 远程封锁其他玩家,封锁到带刀职业则死亡

values.english: Disguises players as others, masking their true identity.
values.schinese: 把其他玩家伪装起来,使他们改变外观

values.english: Plants bombs that detonate if targets fail to kill others.
values.schinese: 在其他人身上放置炸弹,如果那个人不击杀别人,则他将会自爆

values.english: Marks players for delayed death; killable via ghost interaction.
values.schinese: 标记一个玩家下回合死亡;也可通过灵魂交互标记

values.english: Promotes Mafioso; inherits leadership with reduced cooldowns.
values.schinese: 传承帮派;成为领导人后减少冷却时间

values.english: Blinds players with flash grenades, disrupting vision.
Basic Intruder role with kill/sabotage abilities.
Cleans bodies and drags them to hide evidence.
values.schinese: 清理或拖拽尸体,隐藏证据

values.english: Promoted to Godfather upon leader death, gaining buffs.
values.schinese: 教父死后可上位成为教父,上位后获得buff

values.english: Creates vents (Miner) or plants (Herbalist) for mobility.
values.schinese: 挖出管道(矿工)或种出管道(草药师)

values.english: Samples and morphs into other players temporarily.
values.schinese: 获得其他玩家的样本并变成他们

values.english: Marks locations to teleport to later, enabling ambushes.
values.schinese: 标记一个地点以传送,可以用于伏击

values.english: Turns invisible to evade detection and stalk targets.
Basic Syndicate role with early killing access and no special abilities.
values.schinese: 无政府组织的基础职业,没有特殊能力

values.english: Ghostly Syndicate role that blocks non-Syndicate players periodically.
values.schinese: 无政府组织的灵魂职业,可封锁其他非无政府组织玩家

values.english: Places bombs for remote detonation; Chaos Drive triggers all bombs at once.
values.schinese: 放置炸弹并远程引爆;拥有混沌能源则一次性引爆所有炸弹

values.english: Charges players to collide and kill them; Chaos Drive enhances radius.
values.schinese: 给玩家注入正负电荷;拥有混沌能源则加大反应范围

values.english: Makes players invisible; Chaos Drive affects everyone.
values.schinese: 让其他玩家隐身;拥有混沌能源时则影响所有人

values.english: Forces players into lethal alerts; Chaos Drive adds radial kills.
values.schinese: 强制玩家进入警戒模式,让他们击杀与其互动的玩家;拥有混沌能源则击杀附近所有玩家

values.english: Inverts player controls; Chaos Drive applies confusion globally.
values.schinese: 反转玩家操控;拥有混沌能源则影响所有人

values.english: Falsifies investigative results; Chaos Drive frames players in range.
values.schinese: 让别人对你的陷害目标的调查结果错误;拥有混沌能源则从单体变为AOE

values.english: Poisons players for delayed kills; Chaos Drive poisons remotely.
values.schinese: 毒杀玩家(延迟杀);拥有混沌能源则可远程毒杀

values.english: Promotes Sidekicks; gains buffs from Chaos Drive.
values.schinese: 传承组织;通过混沌能源获得buff

values.english: Swaps player appearances; Chaos Drive shuffles everyone.
values.schinese: 交换两人的外表;拥有混沌能源则打乱所有人的外表

values.english: Promoted to Rebel on leader death; inherits enhanced abilities.
values.schinese: 在反叛头领死后变为头领;并获得增益

values.english: Mutes players' chat; Chaos Drive silences everyone except the target.
values.schinese: 让玩家看不见消息,别人也看不到他的消息;拥有混沌能源时则静语除了目标外的所有玩家.

values.english: Curses players to trigger Syndicate victory; Chaos Drive removes cooldown penalties.
values.schinese: 诅咒其他玩家然后让阵营获得胜利;拥有混沌能源则无效冷却时间递增

values.english: Tracks players endlessly; Chaos Drive reveals through camouflage.
values.schinese: 持续追踪玩家;拥有混沌能源则可无视隐蔽效果

values.english: Freezes time or rewinds players; Chaos Drive prioritizes rewinding.
values.schinese: 暂停或回溯时间;拥有混沌能源则优先回溯时间.

values.english: Teleports players; Chaos Drive randomizes all positions.
values.schinese: 传送其他玩家;拥有混沌能源则随机传送所有玩家

values.english: Survives and completes tasks in Hide & Seek mode to win.
values.schinese: 存活并完成任务以获胜

values.english: Kills or converts Hunted in Hide & Seek mode with limited vision.
values.schinese: 在有限的视野下击杀或转化所有躲藏者

values.english: Races to finish tasks first in Task Race mode for instant victory.
values.schinese: 比其他人更快完成所有任务

values.english: Guess roles mid-meeting to kill targets; dies if wrong.
values.schinese: 在会议中猜测玩家职业以击杀他们;猜测错误则死亡

values.english: Call meetings from anywhere, even during sabotages.
values.schinese: 在任意地点召开紧急会议,甚至在破坏时也可

values.english: Reveals anonymous votes after completing tasks.
values.schinese: 完成任务后无视匿名投票

values.english: Performs tasks with a transparent UI overlay.
Kills without lunging animations for stealth.
Votes multiple times or abstains to store votes.
values.schinese: 可以存票,然后瞬间投出

values.english: Shows arrows pointing to the nearest player.
values.schinese: 通过箭头看到离你最近的玩家

values.english: Ignores shields and protections when attacking.
values.schinese: 攻击时无视护盾和守护

values.english: Reveals enemies after tasks; marked to foes when near completion.
values.schinese: 完成任务后揭示敌人身份;即将完成任务时被标记

values.english: Swaps votes between players during meetings.
Breaks vote ties by ejecting their first-voted target.
values.schinese: 平票时,你的投票具有权重

values.english: Gains Intruder vision and sees invisible players.
values.schinese: 获得入侵者视野并且可以看到隐身的玩家

values.english: Gains vent access after completing all tasks.
values.schinese: 完成所有任务后获得跳管能力

values.english: Gains reduced cooldowns when last faction member alive.
values.schinese: 成为阵营最后一人时获得冷却时间减少

values.english: Skips meeting teleportation, staying at their original location.
values.schinese: 进行会议时,你不会被传送,而是带着你现在的位置

values.english: Forces killers to self-report after attacking.
Sees all players as grey to mask identities.

values.schinese: 被杀时增加凶手的击杀冷却时间

values.english: Alerts everyone on death with arrows to their body.
Sees/hears fake events to obscure real threats.
values.schinese: 看到或听到意义不明的音效/特效

values.english: Reveals location to all players continuously.
values.schinese: 持续向所有玩家公开自己位置

values.english: Outcast Killer siding with a faction (Crew/Intruder/Syndicate).
values.schinese: 让被抛弃者带刀职业跟随其他阵营(船员/入侵者/无政府组织)

values.english: Crew member turned killer with faction betrayal.
values.schinese: 船员,但是拥有击杀能力,并且背叛了船员.

values.english: Switches factions when last member of original team.
values.schinese: 成为阵营的最后一人时改变阵营

values.english: Joins attacker's faction upon being targeted.
values.schinese: 加入尝试攻击你的人的阵营

values.english: Wins if linked partner survives, regardless of own fate.
values.schinese: 如果你的兄弟赢了那么你也赢了,不尊重自己的命运))))

values.english: Paired players sharing a private chat and survival goal.
values.schinese: 一对小情侣,拥有私密聊天,活下来就胜利

values.english: Group requiring elimination of all non-Mafia players.
values.schinese: 一群人,需要击杀帮派以外的所有人

values.english: Auto-wins by surviving a set number of meetings.
values.schinese: 存活一定会议数后获得胜利

values.english: Adversarial duo needing indirect elimination of each other.
values.schinese: 决斗,但是不能直接击杀对方,对方死后并存活即可胜利

values.english: Wins by completing tasks before death/game end.
values.schinese: 在游戏结束前或死前做完所有任务则获得胜利

values.english: Crew member defecting to enemy faction after task completion.
values.schinese: 船员完成任务后进行叛变

values.english: Kills players to eventually summon the Void.
values.schinese: 击杀玩家,并且随机生成空洞

values.english: Devours aspects when interacted with, namely losing roles and unreportable bodies.
values.schinese: 与其互动时被吞噬一些东西,如名字般失去其职业并不能报告尸体
民主党人可召开紧急会议
刺客猜测错误不会死亡

values.english: Only The Main Bad Guys Spawn
Disable Venting On Final Two Players
values.schinese: 仅剩余两个玩家时禁用管道

values.english: Assign Chaos Drive On Game Start
values.schinese: 游戏开始时分配混沌能源
